note: Words that were shown another meaning's picture. The app finds a picture by the English gloss alone, so זכות glossed "right" got the arrow drawn for ימין, חג glossed "holiday" got a beach, and רכבת glossed "train" got a coach training runners. data/word-senses.json gives each of them a gloss in its own sense; these are the pictures for the ones a picture can show, filed under that gloss. Until one is drawn the word has no picture, which is better than the wrong one.
